accounting_guard: Includes descendants of the Tarawa-evacuated aircraft already folded into the regional pool; do not add them again. Kyofu/Zuiun are subsets, not additive bonus aircraft.
operational_effect: Hardening and no automatic historical 4-Dec mass raid let the regional pool regenerate into the high-140s serviceable by mid-Jan despite repeated US land-air pressure. This is not one concentrated strike force; useful strength is distributed and many sorties are CAP/search/night attack/repair rotation.
learning_maturity: Priority A-grade bases use the early-Jan post-GALVANIC fixed-base procedural band (+8% to +15% favorable-exchange shift only when warning/plot/radio chain is intact). Do not add a separate generic lesson multiplier.
outer_node_rule: Kusaie/Ponape/Nauru/Wake/Truk add staging, warning and repair depth, not free same-morning Marshall fighter CAP.
